about.text: 🚀 The greatest satisfaction comes from the process of turning an idea into a real project – an application, a website, or content that reaches an audience and delivers tangible results. I value the ability to create solutions from scratch and bring them to a point where they generate business value, reach, or engagement. Every project is an opportunity to combine technology, strategy, and creativity into practical results.
about.text2: 💻 I combine backend and frontend to deliver comprehensive solutions – from intuitive interfaces to efficient systems behind the scenes. I create web applications, websites, and process automations, focusing on functionality, usability, and business value. This allows me to take a project from an idea all the way to a finished product.
about.text3: 🎬 Creating content became a natural complement to my work in IT. I develop projects in video, marketing, and visual communication, using editing tools and strategies that engage audiences. I combine technical knowledge with a creative approach, producing promotional videos, marketing materials, and other types of content that support brands and businesses.
about.text4: 💡 Every project should bring real value. A website – supports business goals, an application – solves specific problems, automation – saves time and resources. I focus on analyzing needs and delivering solutions tailored to users and organizations. For me, growth, efficiency, and quality matter.
about.text5: Outside of IT and marketing projects, I spend a lot of my free time on my own ideas. Currently, I’m tinkering with my own application, experimenting with features and solutions that could make it stand out. I have an idea for a computer game and want to test my skills in game development, and I plan to eventually release it. I combine my passion for games with my technical and creative skills, hoping to create something truly exciting.

headline: Full-stack developer (React · Python/Django) who blends code with video creation

summary.p1: I build web applications end to end — day to day I work with React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, and on the server side with Python (Django, Flask) plus SQL and MongoDB databases. I completed the Web Front-end, Python Back-end and Full Stack Python Developer courses, and my engineering thesis was AureliaHR, a team management app.
summary.p2: My Python scripts were deployed at the company I work for — one of them cut a recurring task from 4–5 days down to two clicks. I also shoot and edit video, so I understand product and marketing, not just code. I run most projects on my own: from understanding the problem, through the docs, to deployment.

company_job.a1: Wrote a Python (pandas) script that processes CSV files with company-car GPS data — a task that took 4–5 days now takes two clicks.
company_job.a2: Built a web scraping script (BeautifulSoup) to analyse competitors' listings on external websites.
company_job.a3: Both tools were deployed and are used in the team's daily work.

freelance.a1: I design and build websites and web apps for small businesses — from a Figma mockup to deployment.
freelance.a2: I shoot and edit ads, reels and social media content.
freelance.a3: I handle client communication, quotes and project schedules on my own.

I build projects — small and large — on my own, which taught me to find answers in documentation and adapt solutions to the project's needs. I use Tailwind in all my projects and know both its strengths and its limits.
frontend.highlight_text: The app helps companies manage teams and reduces communication chaos: employees talk within their own team, and managers handle contact between teams. Managers assign tasks and track their team's progress.

tools.text: I use Git every day — in my own projects and in team projects at university. I work with branches, keep commits and pull requests readable, resolve conflicts and take part in code reviews.
tools.highlight_text: I use GitHub and GitLab along with basic CI/CD features to automate testing and deployment. This website is published on GitHub Pages.

video.highlight_text: As an editor I learned timing, choosing music, writing copy and using AI to streamline work. I know the principles of scripting, shot planning, lighting, framing, color grading and composition.
